catatan: Uji v3.88 setelah koreksi owner 18:37: tanpa berbalik ke kamera, tanpa lompat, kecepatan normal, latar di belakang tokoh ditulis, ketukan kepalan tangan.
lokasi: In front of a small Indonesian family house in the late afternoon: a short tiled front path, a closed wooden front door with a round brass knob, a small terrace with a potted plant, warm golden sunlight.
latar: A quiet residential street in the late afternoon: birds, a distant motorbike, soft wind.

kamera.fokus: Uwais walking with his black backpack

klip.awal: Uwais walks up the tiled front path toward the closed wooden front door, a black backpack on both shoulders, seen from behind.
klip.aksi: He walks at normal speed to the door, stops with both feet flat on the ground, raises his right fist and knocks on the door three times with his knuckles.
klip.akhir: Uwais stands still facing the closed door, seen from behind, his right fist resting lightly against the wood.

foley.suara: three soft knocks on a wooden door

klip.lengan: a loose olive-green overshirt sleeve over an ivory cuff

kamera.fokus: one right hand knocking on the wooden door

klip.aksi: The closed fist knocks on the door three times with the knuckles, short firm taps from the wrist; the door stays shut and nothing happens inside.
klip.akhir: The closed fist rests still against the closed door.

foley.suara: three slow knocks on a wooden door

klip.akhir: Uwais stands still facing the door, his right hand lowered to his side, seen from the side.

klip.akhir: The door stands fully open and Uwais stands in the doorway facing into the house, seen from behind.
klip.ucapan: Pada ke mana ya? Ya sudah, kakak dorong saja.

foley.suara: a wooden door creaking slowly open
